text:
tess: pushed a lightweight "impact_sim" prototype for config rollouts to staging. It replays a sampled traffic snapshot and outputs a compact safety report. Need platform + ops eyes before we wire into console.
omid: How compact? Last time we returned pages of diffs. UI folks wanted a short PASS/FAIL card.
tess: Compact by default: PASS/UNSAFE, safety_score (0-1), top_3_deltas (p95, error_rate, quota_miss). Full detail available in export.
jay: Does it simulate quota enforcement and circuit-breaker behavior or just routing decisions?
tess: Full path: routing -> quota -> circuit checks -> KV/prefix cache hit estimation -> fallback candidate selection.
sylvia: Good. Sampling strategy? We shouldn't run full traces in prod every preview.
tess: Default sample 0.5% over a 30m window. API accepts sample_rate and cohort_filter so you can target orgs/tags.
omid: We need RBAC: who can run sims against production snapshots? I'd restrict to "config-sim" role.
sylvia: Agreed. UI should hide the button if unauthorized and show a request flow for access.
infra-bot: note: impact_sim service cold start ≈ 4s; recommend async request + poll UX.
jay: Policy: if any cohort has abs(delta_quota_miss) > 0.2 -> auto-abort and route to fallback_target. Also if weighted safety_score > 0.07 mark UNSAFE.
tess: I'll make the rollout policy accept preview_threshold and fallback_target. Proposed default: preview_threshold=0.07, fallback_target=stable.
omid: Telemetry: expose metrics config.sim.safety_score, config.sim.duration_ms, config.sim.cohort_skew. Console needs PASS/FAIL + delta_p95 + delta_error + suggested rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) if PASS.
sylvia: UX: safety tab, not inline. Tab shows history of sims with quick compare. Add a small cohort-heatmap and delta histogram to spotlight single-cohort regressions.
jay: Also include a replay_id so teams can re-run an identical sim. Store reports for 30 days and emit audit event config.sim.run with user + snapshot_id.
ops-bot: heads-up: deploy window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for safety tab changes. Tagging ops-team.
tess: Security: mask PII (hash user ids) before storing or showing. We'll only surface hashed cohort ids.
omid: One more: provide an opt-in "conservative_mode" that scales cohort weights towards smaller orgs to avoid tiny-cust regressions being hidden.
sylvia: Nice. That helps catch single-tenant regressions.
jay: Implementation note: make sim idempotent and include snapshot_id + config hash in report metadata.
tess: OK I'll open a PR with API proto: POST /internal/configs/impact_sim -> {config, snapshot_window_mins, sample_rate, cohort_filter, conservative_mode} returns {sim_id, status:PENDING}. Poll GET /internal/sim/{sim_id}/report. Add RBAC + audit + export.
infra-bot: deploy note: staging rollout tomorrow 03:30 UTC, production after sign-off.
ops-bot: ops: FYI @ops-team 1: request any blackout windows for sim runs.
tess: Thanks all, I'll add the telemetry & UI mocks and tag people on the PR.
